newsitem.title: EGYPT: Milling firm shares on sale Sept 15/16.
newsitem.headline: Milling firm shares on sale Sept 15/16.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Rice and Flour Mills said on Thursday it would offer the public shares in Upper Egypt Flour Mills in a privatisation opening on September 15 and closing the next day.

It said the company expected to make an after-tax profit of 44.086 million pounds in the financial year 1996/7, which started on July 1, compared to 42.533 million in 1995/6 and 31.863 million in 1994/5. The company milled 1.128 million tonnes of wheat in 1995/6, it said.
Company officials were not available to say how many shares the holding company would sell and what the price would be.
Upper Egypt Flour Mills will be the fifth milling company to go through partial privatisation since May last year. They have formed one of the most buoyant sectors on the stock exchange.
